title: Best divers over £500
intro_text: Three automatics from the point where money stops buying capability and starts buying finishing. All of them are rated well past anything you are realistically going to ask of a watch: 200 m on the Seiko, 300 m on the Certina and the Longines. The differences that matter here are the ones you notice daily rather than annually. The Seiko is the smallest at 40.5 mm and the only one whose specification confirms a sapphire crystal; the Certina is the largest at 43 mm. Check the exact reference before you buy, because all three of these families span several sizes and movements under the same name.
